verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for an IP office's online services, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only web-based online services (MyCIPO Patents, the online trademark filing system) and downloadable bulk data. Nothing documents an API covering filing, amending, renewing, or paying fees, and bulk data downloads are an adjacent read-only feature, not UI-equivalent API access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
